description: Mean MovieLens rating for this movie.
transformation_or_derivation: Arithmetic mean of rating events grouped by movieId.
notes_or_concerns: Missing when there are no rating events; event averages are less stable for low counts.

description: Number of MovieLens rating events for this movie.
transformation_or_derivation: Count of rating rows grouped by movieId; absent groups set to 0 after left join.
notes_or_concerns: A rating event count, not necessarily a count of distinct people.

description: Standard deviation of MovieLens ratings for this movie.
transformation_or_derivation: Sample standard deviation grouped by movieId.
notes_or_concerns: Missing with no ratings or only one rating.

description: Date/time of the earliest MovieLens rating event.
notes_or_concerns: Missing when the movie has no rating events.

description: Date/time of the latest MovieLens rating event.
notes_or_concerns: Missing when the movie has no rating events.

description: Number of distinct MovieLens users rating this movie.
transformation_or_derivation: Count distinct userId values grouped by movieId; absent groups set to 0.
notes_or_concerns: Users may rate more than one movie.

description: Indicator that a positive revenue value is recorded.
transformation_or_derivation: 1 when numeric revenue is greater than 0; otherwise 0.

description: Whether the movie has enough rating events for the target definition.
transformation_or_derivation: True when user_rating_count is at least 20.
notes_or_concerns: Eligibility rule is a project choice, not a general standard.

description: High MovieLens audience rating label for eligible movies.
transformation_or_derivation: 1 when eligible mean rating is at least 3.75; 0 otherwise; missing when ineligible.
notes_or_concerns: Observed post-release outcome; not a pre-release predictor.
